notes.title: Update! v1.2 (New Maps!)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tTPRSO7.png[/img]

*Added two new maps: Mardin and Erzurum

*Minor performance improvements

*Bug fixes

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – v1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] A new "Continue" system has been added. If you exit the game during a level, you can now return and pick up right where you left off.
[*] 
[*] A "Hint" button has been added. When used, it briefly highlights the location of a cat you haven’t found yet.
[*] 
[*] Separate volume sliders have been added for music and general sound effects.
[*] 
[*] The main menu design has been updated.
[*] 
[*] Unique background music has been added for the Rize and Trabzon levels.
[*] 
[*] The fog in the Rize and Trabzon maps has been made more transparent for improved visibility.
[/list]
